# Certificate of Achievement

[Photo](../README.md) › [Print & Stationery](../README.md#print--stationery) · `print` `certificate` `typography` `shapes` `ornaments` `layer-styles` `groups`

A formal landscape certificate with a navy frame, a guilloche rosette watermark, a gold seal with ribbons and signature lines.

## About

An A4 landscape certificate scaled to 1414 × 1000. The frame is one shape, a rectangle with a
smaller one subtracted, under a thin gold keyline; the watermark is a rosette of 24 rotated
bezier ellipses in one stroked shape layer at low opacity. The seal is a 32-point star with a
Bevel & Emboss and a Gradient Overlay above two ribbon paths, kept with its text in a group,
and the citation is centred paragraph text.
